passages.text: “When all these things come upon you—the blessings and curses I have set before you—and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you, and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today, then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He gave you blessings and curses.
He set these before you.
All these things will come upon you.
You will remember them.
You will be among the nations.
The LORD your God has banished you there.
You and your children will return to the LORD your God.
You will obey His voice.
You will do everything I command you today.
You will obey with all your heart.
You will obey with all your soul.
Then the LORD your God will restore you from captivity.
He will have compassion on you.
He will gather you again.
He will gather you from all the nations.
The LORD your God has scattered you there.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ כִֽי־ יָבֹ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַבְּרָכָה֙ וְהַקְּלָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֙ אֶל־ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ בְּכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדִּיחֲךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃ וְשַׁבְתָּ֞ עַד־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֣ בְקֹל֔וֹ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם אַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ וְשָׁ֨ב יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת־ שְׁבוּתְךָ֖ וְרִחֲמֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁ֗ב וְקִבֶּצְךָ֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֱפִֽיצְךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He has power over all places.
You may be banished far away.
You may be at the farthest edge of the sky.
The LORD your God will gather you from there.
He will take you back from that place.
passages.original: אִם־ יִהְיֶ֥ה נִֽדַּחֲךָ֖ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם מִשָּׁ֗ם יְקַבֶּצְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וּמִשָּׁ֖ם יִקָּחֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will bring you into the land.
Your fathers once possessed this land.
You will take possession of this land.
The LORD will make you prosper there.
The LORD will increase your numbers.
You will become more numerous than your fathers.
passages.original: וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יָרְשׁ֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֥ וְהִרְבְּךָ֖ מֵאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will act on your heart.
The LORD will act on the hearts of your descendants.
He will change your hearts.
He will do this so you can love Him.
You will love the LORD your God.
You will love Him with all your heart.
You will love Him with all your soul.
You will live because of this.
passages.original: וּמָ֨ל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וְאֶת־ לְבַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לְמַ֥עַן חַיֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will act.
The LORD will put all these curses on your enemies.
Your enemies hate you.
Your enemies persecute you.
The LORD will punish those who hate and persecute you.
passages.original: וְנָתַן֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאָל֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה עַל־ אֹיְבֶ֥יךָ וְעַל־ שֹׂנְאֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רְדָפֽוּךָ׃

passages.text: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.
passages.sermon:
You will return to the LORD your God.
You will listen to His voice.
You will do all His commandments.
I am giving you these commandments today.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תָשׁ֔וּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your goodness, as He delighted in that of your fathers, if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will make you prosper.
He will bless all the work of your hands.
He will give you many children.
He will give you many animals.
He will give you much produce from your land.
The LORD will do this for your good.
The LORD will rejoice over you.
He will be glad to do you good.
He rejoiced over your fathers in the past.
He will rejoice over you in the same way.
This will happen if you obey the LORD your God.
You must keep His commandments.
You must keep His statutes.
These are written in this Book of the Law.
You must return to the LORD your God.
You must turn to Him with all your heart.
You must turn to Him with all your soul.
passages.original: וְהוֹתִֽירְךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בְּכֹ֣ל׀ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֗ךָ בִּפְרִ֨י בִטְנְךָ֜ וּבִפְרִ֧י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ לְטוֹבָ֑ה כִּ֣י׀ יָשׁ֣וּב יְהוָ֗ה לָשׂ֤וּשׂ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לְט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֖שׂ עַל־ אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֗ע בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו הַכְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּסֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י תָשׁוּב֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃פ

passages.text: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.
passages.sermon:
Moses speaks to the people of Israel.
He gives them a commandment from God today.
This commandment is not too difficult for you.
This commandment is not beyond your reach.
passages.original: כִּ֚י הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לֹֽא־ נִפְלֵ֥את הִוא֙ מִמְּךָ֔ וְלֹ֥א רְחֹקָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

passages.text: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
passages.sermon:
God gave His commandments to the people of Israel.
These commandments are not far away from you.
The commandment is not in heaven.
You do not need to ask, “Who will go up to heaven for us?”
You do not need someone to bring it down for you.
You do not need someone to make us hear it.
You do not need someone to help us do it.
God’s word is already near you.
passages.original: לֹ֥א בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֤נוּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יְמָה֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃

passages.text: And it is not beyond the sea, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
passages.sermon:
God gave the people of Israel a commandment.
This commandment is not far away from you.
It is not beyond the sea.
You do not need to ask, “Who will cross the sea for us?”
You do not need someone to bring it back for you.
You do not need someone to tell it to you so you can do it.
You can obey this commandment where you are.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיָּ֖ם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲבָר־ לָ֜נוּ אֶל־ עֵ֤בֶר הַיָּם֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃

passages.text: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.
passages.sermon:
God gave His word to the people of Israel.
God’s word is not far away.
God’s word is very near to you.
God’s word is in your mouth.
God’s word is in your heart.
You can do what God commands.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ קָר֥וֹב אֵלֶ֛יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר מְאֹ֑ד בְּפִ֥יךָ וּבִֽלְבָבְךָ֖ לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: See, I have set before you today life and goodness, as well as death and disaster.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God gives them a choice today.
God sets life before them.
God sets goodness before them.
God also sets death before them.
God also sets disaster before them.
passages.original: רְאֵ֨ה נָתַ֤תִּי לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־ הַֽחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַטּ֑וֹב וְאֶת־ הַמָּ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ הָרָֽע׃

passages.text: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, statutes, and ordinances, so that you may live and increase, and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Israel.
He gave them a command from God.
He said, “Today I command you to love the LORD your God.
Walk in His ways.
Keep His commandments.
Keep His statutes.
Keep His ordinances.
If you do these things, you will live.
You will increase in number.
The LORD your God will bless you.
He will bless you in the land you are about to enter and possess.”
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּךָ֮ הַיּוֹם֒ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑יו וְחָיִ֣יתָ וְרָבִ֔יתָ וּבֵֽרַכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them, I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel through Moses.
God warned them about turning away from Him.
If your heart turns away from God, you will not listen to His commands.
If you are led astray, you will bow down to other gods.
You will worship these other gods.
Today, I declare this to you.
If you do these things, you will surely perish.
You will not live long in the land.
You are crossing the Jordan River to enter this land and possess it.
But if you turn away from God, you will not remain there for many days.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יִפְנֶ֥ה לְבָבְךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע וְנִדַּחְתָּ֗ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֛יתָ לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַעֲבַדְתָּֽם׃ הִגַּ֤דְתִּי לָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵד֑וּן לֹא־ תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹבֵר֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹ֥א שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live, and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to all Israel.
Moses called heaven and earth as witnesses.
He did this on that day.
He set two choices before the people.
He set life before them.
He set death before them.
He set blessing before them.
He set cursing before them.
Moses told the people to choose life.
If they choose life, they will live.
Their children will also live.
They must love the LORD their God.
They must listen to His voice.
They must hold fast to Him.
The LORD is their life.
The LORD will give them long days.
The LORD promised this land to their fathers.
He promised it to Abraham.
He promised it to Isaac.
He promised it to Jacob.
He will give this land to them.
passages.original: הַעִידֹ֨תִי בָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָרֶץ֒ הַחַיִּ֤ים וְהַמָּ֙וֶת֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְפָנֶ֔יךָ הַבְּרָכָ֖ה וְהַקְּלָלָ֑ה וּבָֽחַרְתָּ֙ בַּֽחַיִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן תִּחְיֶ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה וְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃ לְאַֽהֲבָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ בְּקֹל֖וֹ וּלְדָבְקָה־ ב֑וֹ כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חַיֶּ֙יךָ֙ וְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמֶ֔יךָ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת עַל־ הָאֲדָמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃פ
